notes.title: Game Updated - List of Changes
notes.notes:
Due to player feedback, the following changes have been made to the game.

Type to Defend 
- A "speed up" notification art is now live for whenever an incorrect letter is typed.

Word Search 
- Is now much easier, words are no longer backwards. 
- New Artwork has been added to show the direction of words.
- New optional "Peek Mode" allows players to hover over a BANZSL letter and view it in English.
- Are now skip-able levels (continue playing the game without completing the Word Search levels).
